description: This file defines the CustomDatatype interface in Java, which specifies methods for handling custom data types within the OpenMRS platform. The interface includes methods for configuration, saving, referencing, validation, and summarizing typed values, as well as a nested Summary class definition.

classes.name: CustomDatatype
classes.description: Interface for custom data type handlers specifying methods for setting configurations, saving values, converting references, validating, and summarizing custom data types.

classes.name: CustomDatatype.Summary
classes.description: A nested class representing a short summary of a custom value, indicating whether the summary is complete.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the datatype configuration provided as a string, defining the format or rules for the custom data type.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists a typed value and returns a reference string for future access; may throw InvalidCustomValueException.

methods.name: getReferenceStringForValue
methods.description: Generates a reference string for a given typed value to enable efficient searching.

methods.name: fromReferenceString
methods.description: Converts a reference string back into its typed value, may throw InvalidCustomValueException.

methods.name: getTextSummary
methods.description: Provides a short, plain-text summary of the referenced value, indicating if it's a full view or a partial summary.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the provided typed value is acceptable according to the datatype's rules.
